system.longDesc:
Capacity: 1 Slot

You have a hidden internal compartment in your torso or your limbs, large enough to contain small items weighing a total of about 2 pounds. It requires a TN 19 Perception (Seeing) test or a full body-scan to locate this compartment when it is closed. In the latter case, it still requires a TN 13 Intelligence (Electronics) test to notice anything unusual.
